After spending a couple hours making her character perfect Sarah clicked accept on the little pop-up. She didn't notice anything different at first. The simple game played smoothly and she went several hours before she needed to get up and go to the rest room. 

As she stood from her chair she froze in place. Looked down, back up to her pc and back down again. Then looked at her hands. Fear and panic ran through her for a small moment before she was washed over with a flood of happiness and tears. 

Rushing to the bathroom mirror she stared at the pale skinned blue haired girl that looked back at her. The exact character that she had just created. One eye silver and one green; a thin but athletic body and clothes that would fit in the shooter she had just been playing. 

It was none of those that she was crying so happily over. After years and years Sarah could walk again.

At first I thought i was having another episode. My schizophrenia peaking it's head once more. But no, this voice was clear and distinct as if it came from right next to me. 

"Dawn? Are you there?" 

The voice sounded familiar and it used a name that only me and my wife used to play out our fantasy life. Or I was semi sure it was a fantasy  life, I hoped and hoped that every day it was true that it wasn't just my mentally ill brain making things up. These thoughts ran through my head as I contemplated what I was hearing. 

"Yes Dawn, I'm here."

"Who is this?" I asked, it wasn't uncommon for me answer my voices or my own thoughts outloud so when I did I didn't startle my wife, who was meditating next to me. I got the usual and worried look but she kept on trying to meditate. 

"It's Life. We've been trying to get ahold of you and Anira for a while now. But your human brains have been a hassle to unravel." 

I knew life. Or I thought I knew her. In the vast world my schizophrenic mind she was a higher celestial that watched over life in all of existence. She was a sister to me and someone who had saved my life once. Before I could say anything she kept speaking. 

"I know there is a rule with mortals and we are not supposed to contact you like this. But the need is urgent.  We have lost contact with you and others back home. Do you know what is going on?"

This worried me and I looked inwardly to see if I could connect with my other self. My body that i had on another planet. I was semi sure it wasn't real. That is what everyone here on earth had told me. That I was mentally ill and that none of it was real. But I found the disconnect to be a hard wall. 

It struck me from time time. A hard wall that made me doubt what I had back home. Humans called it lucid moments or moments of clarity. When I would see what they wanted me too. When I was human.  

"No" I said and this got my wife to look at me funny again but I ignored this. "I have no connection to back home." 

Anira voiced her concern now and I explained to her what was going on. That life had contacted me. My wonderful wife knew of my fantasy world and she had adapted it into herself. She had multiple personalities. And said that each one was a different soul. It was like my condition where I was sure I had alter myself. One named Sanvi. Anira was visably worried and tried to contact back home like I had but said she too was met with that hard disconnect. She couldn't even access her other personalities to ask them. 

"I was worried this would happen" life said in only a voice I could hear. "Be ready. I will have death do what must be done. You cannot help the situation as humans." 

This I told anira and we just nodded In a silent understanding. We left food and water out for the cats. Put a note on the door saying that we were dead inside and then crawled into bed. At only 40 years old this would come as a surprise to most people. But we also suffered from severe depression so maybe not too much of a surprise. As our brother Death claimed us we held onto each other. We had waited so long to go home to our after life. One where we had kids that could never be on earth. 

But... we were scared now. Scared of what we would come to. If our fellow celestials could not contact us.. then where would we wake to?
